title: Amalgamate
summary: AMAL'GAMATE, verb transitive 1. To mix quicksilver with another metal. Gregory uses amalgamize. 2. To mix different things, to make a compound; to unite. AMAL'GAMATE, verb intransitive To mix or unite

inlines.v: AMAL'GAMATE, verb transitive 1. To mix quicksilver with another metal. Gregory uses amalgamize. 2. To mix different things, to make a compound; to unite. AMAL'GAMATE, verb intransitive To mix or unite in an amalgam; to blend.
